We're looking for a marketing intern who wants to manage their own projects and develop creatives that get published.

Great camping experiences start long before guests arrive. At CompuSoft, we build the software that helps campsites turn that first booking into a memorable stay. We’re looking for a marketing intern who wants to take ownership of projects and create content that gets published.

Who We Are

We’re a Danish software company with roots in the camping industry and a story that began in 1987. Today, more than 600 campsites, holiday resorts, attractions, and other tourism businesses use our solutions.

Our technology brings together online booking, guest management, payments, guest apps, and self-service tools. We help businesses simplify daily operations, giving their teams more time to focus on their guests.

With development, sales, and support in-house, we work closely across teams and with our customers to keep improving our solutions.

Your Role:

Your work will cover content, communication, and digital marketing. We’ll shape the internship around your strengths and interests, so tell us what you enjoy working on.

You’ll have your own projects with clear goals and also support the team where needed.

Your tasks may include:

• Writing LinkedIn posts, newsletter articles, and customer stories.

• Creating photos, short videos, and simple graphics.

• Helping plan and run campaigns across our four markets, from trade fairs and webinars to customer events.

• Keeping our messaging clear and consistent across our website, emails, and sales materials.

• Working with our website, email flows, and HubSpot, and tracking results to understand what works.

• Testing new ideas, including ways to use AI tools in our daily marketing work.

...

Who we're looking for

You’re studying marketing, communication, journalism, digital media, or a related subject, and your programme includes an internship.

We hope you:

• Write well in Danish and English. Swedish, Norwegian, or German is a bonus.

• Are curious and enjoy figuring things out independently.

• Have some experience with content, social media, or digital marketing through your studies, work, or personal projects.

• Feel comfortable asking questions and sharing ideas.

You don’t need to know about campsites or software. We’ll teach you that.

What We Offer

You can expect:

• Real responsibility and work you can include in your portfolio.

• A dedicated contact person who makes time for you and provides honest feedback.

• Experience in a growing SaaS company with marketing activities across four markets.

• A place in a team that works closely with sales, product, and customer success.

• A relaxed workplace where we take the work seriously, but not ourselves.

How to Apply

Send a short application and your CV through the application form before December 10. Tell us who you are, what you’d like to work on, and show us one thing you’ve made: a post, an article, a video, or a campaign.

We review applications as they arrive and may fill the position before the deadline.

As Product Owner, you will take full ownership of two global facility monitoring systems (FMS) that track environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, CO2, diff Pressure etc.) across Novo. The FMS supports product release and compliance, so they need clear direction and reliable delivery. You will bring that responsibility in-house, setting the strategy, priorities and budget that keep quality and supply moving.

What you’ll bring

You are preferably already working as a Product Owner and are ready to take clear ownership of a product’s strategy, priorities, backlog and finances.

You will also bring:

• An academic degree preferably in IT or business. Relevant experience counts as much as the path you took to get here.

• Around 3+ years of Product Owner experience, combined with broader relevant experience.

• Strong IT strategic understanding and experience shaping and owning the longer-term direction of a product.

• An understanding of technical and solution architecture at design level. You don’t need to be a deep technical specialist.

• Experience with cost management and budgeting.

• Strong written and spoken English. The team and stakeholder environment is fully international and works in English.

Useful, but not essential:

• Understanding of compliance in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience from production or manufacturing.

• Knowledge of facility monitoring systems, including the FMS solutions used at Novo.

• Experience with agile ways of working.

On a personal level, you bring the maturity to take ownership, make decisions and prioritise competing demands while staying effective under pressure. You are also able to lead informally and build strong stakeholder relationships across functions and cultures.

What you’ll do

The two FMS solutions offer different functionality, so the right one can be chosen for each site and situation. Your job is to give both a clear direction and to make sure the product team delivers what matters most.

• Own the overall direction of both global FMS systems, setting the product strategy and longer-term roadmap.

• Own and prioritise the backlog, deciding what gets delivered and when, based on business needs and input from the product team.

• Lead the product team informally, aligning roles, responsibilities and deliverables so the team works effectively together.

• Manage costs, budgeting and the financial model, making sure costs are covered and following up on actual spend against budget.

• Manage stakeholders proactively. Spot potential issues early and bring the right people in before problems escalate.

• Act as the first escalation point when significant issues arise with the product or its implementations, and set a clear example on quality.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Monitoring and Control Solutions, the area that sets the strategic direction for global monitoring and control systems at Novo. The team is based at the Novo IT hub in Høje Taastrup, Denmark, and works closely online with stakeholders and the application vendor around the world. You can expect to spend much of your week in the office with your team.

Your closest colleagues will be your product team: a Product Manager, Business Analysts, Implementation Leads, a Compliance Partner, a Solution Architect and System Managers. Beyond the team, you will coordinate with Line of Business, implementation teams, lifecycle management, architecture and the application vendors. The systems serve factories and laboratories globally, so your priorities will affect sites across many countries and cultures. Your role is to bring these perspectives together, create clarity when things stall and keep work moving at pace.

What you can expect here

This is a role with real ownership. You will be trusted to make decisions about two global systems, and your voice will shape where they go next. You will build broad experience across IT strategy, finance, architecture and manufacturing-related compliance, all in one product area.

You will work in a team that values a quality mindset, honest dialogue and an informal working climate, where colleagues support each other and never compromise on quality. Clear priorities and ambitious goals mean your results will be visible and recognised.

What we offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

As CMMS & Spare Parts Management Lead, you will help centralise and strengthen our computerised maintenance management system (CMMS) and spare parts management, supporting implementation of the Novo Nordisk Reliability and Maintenance blueprint. By connecting systems, master data, processes and people, you will help make maintenance activities more reliable and create practical improvements for daily production.

You bring hands-on expertise in SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) and Materials Management (MM), combined with an understanding of how maintenance systems and reliable master data support production. The role combines development of maintenance capabilities with a close connection to daily production, giving you exposure to a broad stakeholder landscape across Site Gentofte.

As Process Engineer in API Manufacturing in Kalundborg, you will help bring a new product into large-scale production. You will combine your chemistry or biochemistry knowledge with process data to understand the molecule, the reactions and the purification steps, and turn that insight into stable, compliant and efficient manufacturing. As the product moves from project into operations, you will take growing ownership and help more people living with diabetes and other serious chronic diseases get the treatment they need.

What you’ll bring

You understand manufacturing at a molecular, chemical and biochemical level, take ownership and stay constructive when priorities change. You will typically have:

• A Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD in biochemistry, chemistry, biotechnology, biomedicine, chemical engineering or another relevant life-science discipline.

• Relevant experience from pharmaceutical manufacturing, API production, biotechnology or another chemistry-intensive production environment.

• Practical knowledge of one or more areas such as chemical modification, protein chemistry, organic chemistry, downstream processing, purification, filtration or HPLC.

• Working knowledge of cGMP in a regulated setting.

• Strong English communication skills and the ability to share knowledge, collaborate across functions and influence decisions.

• Curiosity, a proactive approach and enjoyment in solving complex challenges.

Useful, but not essential:

• Hands-on experience with deviations, investigations, change control, qualification or validation.

What you’ll do

You will strengthen product and process understanding in a state-of-the-art production environment and support the transfer of a new product from development into operations.

• Build a detailed understanding of how the molecule, chemical modification, protein chemistry and purification steps affect the final product.

• Analyse process data to find correlations and root causes, and turn the findings into practical improvements and monitoring.

• Support qualification and validation activities in line with cGMP requirements, and the implementation of new products and processes.

• Take ownership of product-related activities such as deviations, investigations, change requests, product transfers and continuous improvement.

• Share your specialist knowledge, contribute to technical decisions and help build capability in a growing team.

Priorities may shift as the organisation moves into operations. You will have the chance to help shape effective ways of working and how the team supports products and processes in the future.

Who you’ll work with

You will join a growing team in API Manufacturing at Novo Manufacturing Kalundborg, a leading production hub for insulins and GLP-1 analogues that support millions of people living with diabetes and other chronic diseases. Several colleagues are joining the area at the same time, so you can influence the team’s technical direction and its specialist culture from the start.

You will work with specialists in production, development, quality and engineering who continuously improve how we manufacture. Together you will connect scientific insight to practical decisions, with broad exposure to product changes, development activities and manufacturing challenges.

Please note: there will be manufacturing, storage or handling of semi-finished or finished GLP-1 products in the work location (building), regardless of whether you will directly handle the products.

You will be supported to grow your skills while being trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard. Working across production, development, quality and engineering gives you broad experience of the value chain, and a growing team means room to build your expertise alongside colleagues who share it. Do you have experience with Reference Standards and are you passionate about creating a broad collaboration with Contract Manufacturing Organizations and internal stakeholders? Ready for your next career move? If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Reference Standard Specialist.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Reference Standard Specialist to join our growing team. As a key member of the Reference Standard team, you will become point of contact in reference standard matters between Ascendis Pharma and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) on specified projects. You will work to ensure continuous good relations and alignment with CMOs worldwide and stay updated with insights into their methods and processes together with our QC specialists. It is expected that in the collaboration you will contribute to areas such as analytical testing and test methods as well as regulatory guidelines and requirements on reference standards. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

Your typical workday will consist of discussions and support together with a small team of highly experienced colleagues. You will report directly to Therese Lindin, Associate Director for Reference Standards,who is based in Hellerup, and you will also be working at our headquarters in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Plan, coordinate and document activities regarding establishment, maintenance, re-supply, recalibration and distribution/shipping of reference standards and critical analytical substances

• Establish and maintain overview of reference standards for all purposes and product phases (development and commercial manufacturing) including storage location, stock, stability, expiry etc. for current standards as well as standards needed in the future to ensure availability of required standards

• Establish and maintain internal guidance (SOP or guides) for reference standards

• Make sure relevant updates of external legislation and guidelines for reference standards are implemented in the Ascendis Pharma QMS

• Contribute as an author on regulatory documents, such as IMPD's, IND's, NDA's and BLA's and provide answers to questions from authorities - in writing or face to face during inspections. Further, contribute to assessment of inspection readiness of CMO's

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a masters in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering, or other relevant education - and a minimum of 5 years of experience from Biotech or Pharmaceutical industry working with reference standards.

Your knowledge and experience within the reference standard area will enable you to guide project teams at CMOs through conceptual as well as specific practical discussions. You have experience with coordination of reference standard activities, and experience with the commercial setup for resupply of reference standards. It will be an advantage if you have experience with analysis of large molecules, and preferably with polymers, proteins and/or peptides as well.

Furthermore, knowledge and practical experience in analytical sciences from the pharmaceutical industry within chromatographic analyses (HPLC) and bioassays, either from an analytical development laboratory or from a QC Laboratory will be an advantage.

Key competencies:

You have a structured and systematic approach to solving tasks and possess outstanding skills in collaboration and communication. As the job involves many stakeholders and coordination of activities both internally and externally, you thrive with being in contact with new people. You are a highly motivated individual who enjoys being challenged and working in collaborative environments. You possess a high energy level and focus on details.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to have excellent abilities in terms of keeping an overview even with many active tasks at the same time. You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude. Criteria of success in the role will be to ensure efficient coordination of reference standard activities for development projects as well as post-approval resupply activities. Moreover, you are expected to actively contribute to the establishment of continuous improvements to our reference standard programs and establish close and high-standard collaborations with the CMOs and internally in Ascendis Pharma.

jobs.occupation: PhD Stipend in Experimental Quantum Materials Physics
jobs.description:
Join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production at Aalborg University and contribute to research on the quantum properties of matter at the scale of individual atoms and molecules. This is a full-time, fixed-term PhD stipend for three years, commencing on 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter

**Your work tasks

**The Department of Materials and Production is looking for a PhD candidate in experimental physics to investigate how molecular complexes can be used to engineer quantum properties in materials. The project addresses fundamental questions in quantum science while contributing knowledge that may support future applications within electronics, sensing and energy harvesting. You will become part of the Physics Group and work in an international research collaboration funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark.

Your research will focus on preparing and investigating molecular complexes on crystalline surfaces. You will deposit molecular complexes by electrospray techniques under ultra-high-vacuum conditions and study their structural and electronic properties using low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. The work will involve planning and conducting experiments, documenting methods and results, analysing and discussing data, and communicating findings clearly within the research collaboration and through relevant scientific channels. You will carry out a substantial part of the research independently while collaborating closely with researchers in the project.

Your competencies You hold a master's degree in physics, nanoscience or a closely related field. You have a solid experimental background within physics, surface science or nanoscience, together with documented experience in scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, ultra-high-vacuum techniques, cryogenic systems, surface science and electrospray deposition.

You can organise and conduct experimental research in a systematic manner, from the planning of measurements to the documentation, analysis and interpretation of results. You communicate methods and findings clearly in English, both in writing and in dialogue with other researchers. The position calls for a researcher who can take responsibility for their own work while contributing constructively to a collaborative and international research environment.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are

You will join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production, where research activities explore materials and physical phenomena relevant to both fundamental science and future technologies. In this position, you will work at the intersection of molecular science, surface science and quantum materials research, with access to a research environment in which experimental methods and scientific discussion form the basis for developing new knowledge.

As part of an international collaboration, you will have the opportunity to engage with researchers across disciplines and contribute to a research project with both scientific depth and technological relevance. The position offers a strong foundation for further work in academic research, advanced experimental physics or research-intensive development environments.

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

QuNorth is looking for a Quantum Error Correction (QEC) Lead to help develop and lead our collaborative Quantum Error Correction program, in addition to participating in other aspects of operationalizing Magne, QuNorth’s Neutral Atom quantum computer, in a fast-paced but stable startup environment.

QuNorth is a new Nordic Hub for quantum exploration, providing the region’s enterprises, researchers, and startups with the capability to test, learn, and build on Magne, a world-leading Level 2 quantum computer. With strong backing from EIFO and the Novo Nordisk Foundation, QuNorth will operate Magne as a shared platform for Nordic industries, research organisations, and start-ups. Our aim is to provide the access, tools, expertise, and support needed to explore new quantum applications across all relevant areas, including, but not limited to, life sciences, innovative materials, biochemistry, and AI.

Magne’s physical layer, developed by Atom Computing, includes 1200+ Ytterbium-171 atoms, serving as physical qubits with all-to-all connectivity. It can be operated seamlessly in logical mode enabled by Microsoft, providing tens of logical qubits depending on QEC code. Magne can also be operated in physical mode with mid-circuit measurement and feedforward, which in conjunction with its all-to-all connectivity at scale turns Magne into an excellent platform for exploration of novel QEC techniques, unconstrained by “chip topology”. We envision QEC projects and broader QEC-related partnerships to be a strong component of QuNorth’s portfolio. Working directly with the CTO, and interfacing with the CPO team and QuNorth’s users and partners, the QEC Lead will help shape this key component of the QuNorth portfolio. • Collaborate with system, antenna, signal-processing, test, mechanical, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

• Demonstrated ability to bring up, tune, troubleshoot, and validate RF hardware and correlate measured results with simulations.

• Experience taking RF hardware through prototype manufacturing, assembly, design verification, environmental requirements and qualification, and production release.

Nice to have

• Experience with SDR-based radio architecture.

• Experience designing wideband, high-dynamic-range, low-noise receiver systems.

• Experience with coherent or multichannel RF systems, including channel matching, phase stability, and synchronization.

• Experience developing aerospace, mission-critical, or ruggedized electronic systems.

• Experience developing RF and microwave hardware operating at frequencies up to and beyond 18GHz.

Success in the first 6 months

jobs.description:
_**Imagine if robust test methods and reliable test equipment helped ensure the quality of both new and existing Coloplast products. That is where you come in.

**_As our new Test Method Specialist, you will become the technical focal point for selected test methods and related equipment in Coloplast Mørdrup, primarily supporting the QA Lifecycle Laboratory and Pilot SVS. You will support the full test method and equipment lifecycle, from implementation and qualification to maintenance, transfer and continuous improvement.

If you are motivated by hands-on technical problem-solving, equipment responsibility, quality assurance and data evaluation, this role offers meaningful responsibility and broad organisational impact. You will also work closely with many internal and external stakeholders, making clear communication, coordination and strong stakeholder management an important part of your success.

_“In this role, your technical judgement and ability to create robust solutions will help ensure reliable test results and compliant laboratory processes throughout the product lifecycle,” says Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory.

_**Join a skilled and collaborative laboratory team

**At our Coloplast Mørdrup site, you will join the Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory. The team consists of laboratory technicians and test method specialists who work closely together to support ongoing production, process development, quality investigations and test method activities.

You will be part of an engaged team with a strong mix of practical laboratory experience and specialist knowledge. In our daily work, we collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Research and Development, Operations, Global Test Method teams and international manufacturing sites. We value curiosity, knowledge sharing, flexibility and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Own and develop test methods and equipment

**As Test Method Specialist, you will act as a one-point contact and technical superuser for selected test methods and test equipment. A significant part of the role is practical equipment responsibility. You will work hands-on with equipment and coordinate activities to ensure it is qualified, calibrated, serviced, maintained and performing as intended. You will also support software and computer upgrades connected to the equipment, as well as reliable data handling and traceability.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Acting as technical owner and one-point contact for selected test methods and related test equipment

• Planning, coordinating and performing qualification of test equipment, including relocation, capacity expansion and replacement of critical parts

• Preparing and maintaining qualification protocols, reports, procedures, test method documentation and one-point lessons when needed

• Performing hands-on troubleshooting of test equipment and methods, evaluating test results and leading root cause investigations when failures occur

• Taking practical responsibility for test equipment, including service activities, calibration follow-up, preventive maintenance and ensuring that equipment performs as intended

• Handling changes, nonconformities and CAPAs related to test methods, calibration and test equipment

• Supporting compliant storage and traceability of raw data before product release

• Planning and participating in transfers of test methods and equipment to international manufacturing sites

• Providing technical support and sparring to colleagues in the Pilot Plant, Global Operations and international manufacturing sites

• Collaborating with Global Test Method teams and contributing technical input to the development and improvement of test methods

• Coordinating software and computer upgrades for test equipment, assessing their impact on qualification and documentation, and managing suppliers, service visits and relevant service agreements

• Participating in internal and external audits related to test methods, equipment and documentation

• Contributing to continuous improvement of laboratory processes, systems and ways of working

**Bring strong technical judgement and a quality mindset

**To succeed in this position, you combine technical depth with a structured, practical and hands-on approach. You enjoy working directly with equipment, take ownership and work systematically when resolving technical issues. You are comfortable making decisions based on data, risk and regulatory requirements.

The role involves close collaboration with many internal and external stakeholders, therefor you communicate clearly, coordinate effectively and are able to build strong working relationships across functions, sites and suppliers.

We imagine that you bring:

• A master’s degree within science, engineering, mechanics, physics, chemistry, pharmacy or a comparable technical field, or have at least five years of relevant experience with test methods

• Solid hands-on experience with test methods, measurement principles and qualification of laboratory or production test equipment

• Strong problem-solving skills and experience with structured root cause analysis

• Confident evaluating, analysing and presenting technical data skills, including the use of statistical methods

• Ability to write, review and understand technical documentation, protocols and reports

• Knowledge of quality systems and regulated environments; knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 and GMP is an advantage

• An understanding of validation, calibration, design control, specifications and process risk management

• Abitlity to plan and prioritise your work effectively and follow activities through to completion

• Strong stakeholder management skills and collaborate effectively across disciplines, functions, geographical locations and external suppliers

• Communicating skills professionally in English, both written and spoken; Danish is an advantage

• A comfortable competence using digital tools for documentation, data analysis and traceability; experience with Microsoft Office, Veeva, JMP or similar systems is an advantage

**A specialist role with broad impact

**This is a permanent specialist position in the QA Lifecycle Laboratory. The role has no direct reports and includes collaboration with international colleagues and manufacturing sites. Some travel may be expected in connection with transfers, supplier activities and site support.

You will join a working environment where quality, safety, technical excellence, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are central to our daily work. You will have the opportunity to build a broad network and influence how test methods and equipment are managed across the product lifecycle.
